notes.title: Version 1.1.6 Update
notes.content: [p]Version 1.1.6[/p][p][/p][p]Rebalancing and minor bug fixes[/p][p][/p][p]- Regular difficulty rebalanced[/p][p]- Bonus life score targets rebalanced[/p][p]- Locale update[/p][p]- Fix achievements - Lightning Fighter, Convoy Raider and Precision Fighter[/p][p]- Fix and remember difficulty mode default and last setting[/p][p]- Fix minor graphical issues[/p][p]- Fix boss 5 weapons launching immediately[/p]

notes.title: Patch #1 and Deluxe Edition is here!
notes.content:
[h3]Patch #1[/h3][p]We understand there are a wide range of gamers looking for different experiences from the game, from long time fans and Shoot 'em up players to those preferring a less frantic flight to Colossatropolis, so we have good news for you! 

Our first patch includes:
- All new Easy difficulty, making a total of 5 difficulty levels[/p][p]- Previous difficulties moved up one rank[/p][p]- Easy and Regular modes have several stress-reducing quality of life improvements[/p][p]- Difficulty descriptions to help you choose your game style[/p][p]- Various bug fixes[/p][p]We’re already working on the next patch which focuses on Steam Workshop and built-in music customisation support. Free additional content is in the works too![/p][p][/p][h3]Platypus Reclayed Deluxe edition is available now![/h3][p]The best way to enjoy the Game, Music and Art of Platypus Reclayed. A treat for all Platypus fans and those interested in the games music and unique production. [/p][p][/p][h3]The Original Sound Track (OST)[/h3][p]Includes all the music from the game (so far…) - 15 tracks in total - featuring selections from legendary remix albums of classic Commodore 64 chiptunes including the “Back in Time” series and Karma 64, iconic tracks such as “Wizball 2000”, “Comic Bakery” and "Sanxion" makes this soundtrack legendary on its own.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Art book[/h3][p]Featuring a look at the game’s unique creation process. Learn about how the game's production pipeline has changed over the years from Anthony Flack, accompanied by photographs from the studio and beautiful high resolution images of game models, and plenty more besides.


[b]Patch #1[/b] [b]Changelist[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new difficulty "Easy" with more forgiving level setup and enemy behaviour. Additionally players regain pods whenever they lose a life[/p][/*][*][p]All existing difficulties moved up one difficulty level[/p][/*][*][p]Added difficulty selection description to the UI[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra invulnerability states to "Easy" and "Regular" difficulties so you're briefly protected after collecting a power-up and adjusted invulnerability timings[/p][/*][*][p]Regular difficulty icon features a smile :)[/p][/*][*][p]Ship stat adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Player homing missiles now move faster (more changes under discussion)[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy homing missiles now move slower, on lower difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Crates containing weapon pods will deliver a weapon pod if you only have 1 rather than an extra life[/p][/*][*][p]Beginner ship is default on first-time start-up[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced player hitbox size[/p][/*][*][p]Minor level tweaks including to passive resistance[/p][/*][*][p]Boss tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Super Gunship and Thruster Ship explosions increased [/p][/*][*][p]Lowered opening splash video volume[/p][/*][*][p]Modding: Data changes (mods will need to be updated - see modding docs)[/p][/*][*][p]Modding: Font added to mod pack[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Ship UI in Score Attack[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Score saving bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for various localisation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for restarting Score Attack using left mouse button[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for languages using a capital 'i' that is not an 'I'[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for player crash score missing on Score Attack[/p][/*][*][p]Fix with with certain achievements not being awarded in 2 player[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for unlock all giving certain achievements [/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Steam cloud saves[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Steam achievement status reports[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Boss 5 death[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for bonus score issue when score is 0[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for invincibility on spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Colossatropolis spelling lessons… again!
[/p][/*][/list]

[/p][p][b]Reprogrammed from scratch and updated for modern hardware..[/b] [/p][p]Platypus Reclayed is moulded from the ground up with all-new models and artwork photographed in 4k widescreen, featuring updated gameplay, new weapons and additional content. notes.title: Platypus Reclayed featured in the National Video Game Museum
notes.content:
[h2]Exciting news! [/h2][p][/p][p]Platypus Reclayed is part of the new [url="https://thenvm.org/make-it-play-it/"][u][b]Make It! Play it![/b][/u][/url] exhibition at the [url="https://thenvm.org/"][u][b]National Videogame Museum[/b][/u][/url] in Sheffield, UK.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/165b8122e49476132f7280a02e1511ec38a991ca.png"][/img][/p][p]Play Platypus Reclayed at the show (before release), view original clay models made by artist Anthony Flack that feature in the game and find out more about our creative process!  

The exhibition runs from [b]July 24[/b] and celebrates how developers use tools like 3D modelling, pixel art, sound design, embroidery, clay modelling, and stop-motion animation to create games.

The show also celebrates 30 years of [b][u][url="https://www.lego.com/"]LEGO[/url][/u][/b] videogames, with a colourful mix of playable classics and rarely seen objects from both the Museum’s and The LEGO Group’s own collection.

Other ways of making are explored through the embroidered world of [b][u][url="https://www.scarletdeerinn.com/"]Scarlet Deer Inn[/url][/u][/b] and immerse hand-painted landscapes of [b][url="https://www.themasterspupil.com/"][u]The Master’s Pupil[/u][/url][/b].[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/1fab3d053272b732d349fffe2a3302c1de85c0fc.png"][/img][/p][p]The museum has free drop-in sessions throughout the summer to get you making, and any ticket purchased to visit the Museum from [b]24th July[/b] [b]to[/b] [b]1st September 2025[/b] can be used again to return for free - As many times as you like! Find out more [url="https://thenvm.org/playallsummer/"][u][b]here[/b][/u][/url]. 

The museum features over 100 playable exhibits, from retro arcade machines to modern gaming experiences, alongside carefully curated displays.

Big big thanks to the National Videogame Museum team for all your hard work in organising the exhibition. It’s an honour to be showcased alongside so many amazing games. 

Thanks to all of you for your support and stay tuned for more Platypus Reclayed news soon! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/f2babee48da71734d7dc125d9f7674ce469f3db0.png"][/img][/p][p]
If you’re able to make it let us know what you think and share across our socials:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/claymatic"][b]Discord[/b][/url][b] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ClaymaticGames"]YouTube[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.instagram.com/claymaticgames"]Instagram [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@claymaticgames?lang=en"]TikTok[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/claymatic.games"]Bluesky [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://twitter.com/ClaymaticGames"]Twitter[/url][/b][/p]

notes.title: Platypus Reclayed Fan Art Showcase
notes.content:
[p]We’ve added new Fan Art channels for our claymation shoot 'em up, Platypus Reclayed - And our slapstick brawler, Clodhoppers to our [b][url="http://discord.gg/claymatic"]Discord Server[/url][/b][b].[/b]

Your artwork have blown us away! - Here are some of our favourite Platypus highlights:[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/7fc3f43872dde6224a2e7ba6b6cccd4e0c37b199.jpg"][/img]Artist: CLETTUCE[/h3][p]Our most passionate Cletus fan has rendered us some fan art of the three player ships - Featuring the Platypus, Plover and Wyvern personified - Lovely work![/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/b5a1f31915f5b82d5ae4ab812d094a89d6fbe183.png"][/img]Artist: Limniad[/h3][p]Working with clay again? Nice! - Limniad has built two F-27s representing Players 1 and 2 from Platypus Classic - They've been equipped with the Rockets and Wideshot.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/fd715b45bc5d374ca858dcb364586efeffac2881.png"][/img]Artist: Deridiya[/h3][p]Deridiya has painted a beautiful piece of the F-27 venturing through the Volcanic Archipelago - However, some dangerous weather has swept in.. notes.title: Platypus Reclayed Joins Steam Next Fest on June 9-16!
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce that Platypus Reclayed will be taking part in Steam Next Fest from June 9th to 16th with our first Steam playable demo!

Creator Anthony Flack has curated selected levels for you to play, complete with different difficulty options, perfect for both long-time fans and first-time flyers!

Back in April, we showcased a small demo at the London Games Festival - it was so enthusiastically received that we thought we should create a completely new demo for the wider community. That means even if you played at the LGF, we’re giving you even more to try out! 

[b]Steam Next Fest Demo Highlights[/b]

 🕹️ Casual arcade shooting mayhem

🍠 A sneak peek at the new levels

🚀 New ships and weapons

🎶 Engrossing soundtrack with an irresistible retro vibe

🎨 Fully clay-animated visuals (fingerprints included)

🧡 Couch co-op

Mark your calendars and get ready for claylicious chaos! Platypus Reclayed launches in 2025 on PC and consoles but you can dive into the madness early on June 9th 2025.

notes.title: Platypus Reclayed Selected for Best in British at the London Games Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/1acf9edb6d6aecf7d163b128ff89c79ef8825bd5.png[/img]

We’re stoked to announce that Platypus Reclayed has been selected for the Best in British showcase at this year’s London Games Festival! 

This prestigious event celebrates the very best in UK game development and we’re honoured to be among some amazing studios representing British creativity in the gaming industry.

The London Games Festival runs from April 2nd - 13th 2025, tickets can be purchased now: [url=https://tickets.games.london]https://tickets.games.london[/url]

As part of the official selection, Platypus Reclayed will be featured in dedicated events - watch this space for news and updates.

We couldn’t have reached this amazing milestone without the support of our fantastic community and we are really excited to share this special moment with you. 

If you are attending the festival, please let us know on our Discord server!

notes.title: Platypus Reclayed - Design an Enemy Competition
notes.content:
Grab your drawing (or sculpting) tools and help us design a new Enemy Ship for Platypus Reclayed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/1e84179a29db3bed58f3923dee4fbb8125f4004e.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Here's how you can participate:

[list]
[*] First, review our Terms & Conditions for entry - [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iLdMJjKYIKNBRqb-oH4BlGexWvkYqIY-FCz9-93YrIE/edit?usp=sharing][b]Link[/b][/url]
[*] Design a small enemy or medium sized tougher enemy - Drawing or model, whatever you prefer!
[*] Flight/attack patterns are optional (they will be subject to change), but feel free to share your ideas!
[*] Once you've got your submission ready, share it on one of our channels:

  ○ Claymatic Games Discord - [url=https://ptb.discord.com/channels/334342069755576322/1315653334115287060][b]Submissions[/b][/url] Channel
  ○ Twitter/X - @ClaymaticGames using  [b]#ReclayPlatypus[/b]
  ○ Bluesky - @claymatic.games using  [b]#ReclayPlatypus[/b]
[/list]
Anthony will choose the competition winner and their design will be featured in Platypus Reclayed.

The winner will also receive a free digital copy of the game and be listed in the game’s credits - Sweet!

[hr][/hr]
[b]The competition will run from December 12th to January 12th.[/b]

Good luck and thank you for participating!
